title: lathyrus inconspicuus var. stans
intro: Lathyrus inconspicuus var. stans, commonly known as Indian pea or grass pea, is a perennial legume plant native to the Indian subcontinent. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating digestive issues, kidney stones, and respiratory problems. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of certain conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus inconspicuus var. stans include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
